name: manual_5ea2a3
claim: A security race regression is only evidence when it perturbs the production branch actually used on that platform; descriptor-relative POSIX tests should inject after the directory descriptor opens and assert fail-closed behavior if the pathname is replaced.

decisions.notes: The first Periscope race test patched tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile, which the POSIX implementation never uses. Patching _open_local_directory exposed the real result: an unlink-and-symlink replacement cannot redirect the write and instead fails closed.
